'''Laura Beatriz Steren''' (born 11 January 1963) is an Argentine nanoscientist. A 2007 [[Guggenheim Fellow]], she is a researcher at the [[National Scientific and Technical Research Council]] (CONICET).
==Biography==
Laura Beatriz Steren was born on 11 January 1963 in Rosario.<ref name="GF"/> She obtained a BS from the [[National University of Rosario]] in 1986 and a PhD from the [[Balseiro Institute]] and [[National University of Cuyo]] in 1992;<ref name="GF"/><ref name="conicet"/> her doctoral dissertation was titled ''Magnetismo en cupratos superconductores de alta temperatura crítica y compuestos relacionados''.<ref name="conicet"/>

In 1993, Steren joined the [[Laboratoire de Physique des Solides]] as a [[National Scientific and Technical Research Council]] (CONICET) postdoctoral fellow, serving until 1995.<ref name="GF"/> In 1996, she moved to the [[Bariloche Atomic Centre]]'s Magnetic Resonance Laboratory as a CONICET Associate Researcher.<ref name="GF"/> She also became an associate professor at the [[Balseiro Institute]] in 1998, and directed their master programme in physics from 2002 until 2004.<ref name="GF"/> In 2003, she was a visiting professor at the [[Sabato Institute of Technology]].<ref name="GF"/>

Steren became a CONICET independent researcher in 2003,<ref name="GF"/> and later became a senior researcher with them.<ref name="conicet"/> By 2023, she had been appointed deputy director of the CONICET/[[National Atomic Energy Commission]] Institute of Nanoscience and Nanotechnology.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2023-07-31 |title=CNEA y CONICET afianzan su trayectoria conjunta en nanociencia y nanotecnología |url=https://cuestionentrerriana.com.ar/cnea-y-conicet-afianzan-su-trayectoria-conjunta-en-nanociencia-y-nanotecnologia/ |access-date=2026-10-27 |website=Cuestión Entrerriana |language=es-AR}}</ref>

Steren's academic specialty is in magnetic nanotechnology.<ref name="conicet"/> In 2007, she was awarded a [[Guggenheim Fellowship]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Laura B. Steren |url=https://www.gf.org/fellows/laura-b-steren/ |access-date=2026-10-27 |website=Guggenheim Fellowships}}</ref> for a "study of spin-polarized transport phenomena in artificial magnetic nanostructures".<ref name="GF"/> He and Martin Sirena co-authored a book published by the [[Editorial Académica Española]] in 2012.<ref name="conicet"/> In 2017, she coordinated the Argentina chapter of the European Union-funded SPICOLOST project on developing nanostructures to reduce cell phone energy usage.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2017-01-09 |title=Científicos argentinos trabajan en un proyecto para bajar el consumo de energía en celulares |url=https://www.elpatagonico.com/cientificos-argentinos-trabajan-un-proyecto-bajar-el-consumo-energia-celulares-n1530536 |access-date=2026-10-27 |website=El Patagónico}}</ref>
